items.title: Lester Santiago Interview, 1959-01-09
items.q: Harold told me, he said, well, Leslie said you're a fine piano player, but they're going to have to leave you go, he said, because you don't read.

ctx.x: From New Orleans to New York City. And while traveling on a ship, they decided that the band would have to play to entertain the passengers. And those people had their own music. So they presented me the music on one trip, and I told them I didn't know how to read. So they got someone from off the ship, a passenger, to play my part. So Harold told me, he said, well, Leslie said you're a fine piano player, but they're going to have to leave you go, he said, because you don't read. He said, I've been behind you to…
Yeah, I worked with Larry too.
